articles.title: Etsy is cracking down on AI slop listings
articles.que_paso: Etsy announced new rules that force sellers to include an unedited photo of the actual product as the primary image and to label any AI‑generated images, aiming to curb misleading AI‑created listings.
datos: The primary listing photo must be an unedited image of the item against a real background
All other photos may be edited only if the final image still accurately represents the physical product
If Etsy’s system flags a potential AI‑generated image, a pop‑up asks the seller to confirm its origin
Listings created by bots are now prohibited
Sellers of functional guides must provide an actual result made from the guide and cannot use AI‑generated content
AI‑generated artwork can remain on Etsy only if the seller explicitly discloses its AI origin
articles.conclusion: The policy seeks to protect buyer confidence and forces sellers to adjust their image workflows, potentially increasing compliance costs but reducing deceptive listings.

articles.title: Justice Dept. Opens Inquiry Into Corey Lewandowski
articles.que_paso: The Justice Department has launched an investigation focusing on Corey Lewandowski, a former senior adviser to Donald Trump. The probe concerns possible misconduct that may have occurred while Trump was in his second presidential term, though the department has not released details.
datos: The U.S. Justice Department announced an inquiry into Corey Lewandowski.
Lewandowski served as a senior adviser to former President Donald Trump.
The investigation relates to actions taken during Trump’s second term (2017‑2021).
The Justice Department has not disclosed specifics of the inquiry.
Investigations of Trump allies from the second term are described as rare.
articles.conclusion: The case signals that former administration officials can face federal scrutiny years later, highlighting the need for rigorous compliance in political operations.

articles.title: Key Trump Health Adviser Resigns Ahead of Midterm Elections
articles.que_paso: Calley Means, a senior health adviser to President Trump, announced his resignation, citing frustration with the stalled MAHA agenda; his departure comes as he had previously facilitated a political bridge between Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and advocated for food‑policy reforms.
datos: Calley Means served as President Trump's health adviser.
He previously helped unite Robert F. Kennedy Jr. with President Trump.
Means advocated for food reforms during his tenure.
He resigned citing stalled progress on the MAHA agenda.
The resignation was announced ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
articles.conclusion: The exit removes a key liaison between the administration and a high‑profile anti‑vaccine figure, potentially weakening food‑policy initiatives and altering the health narrative before the upcoming elections.

articles.title: Palmer Luckey Made a Genetically Modified Military Dog Startup
articles.que_paso: A new Texas‑based startup called Warhound, founded by Anduril co‑founder Palmer Luckey and Colossal Biosciences co‑founder Ben Lamm, announced today that it will gene‑edit and clone elite working dogs for the U.S. military, police and first responders. The company has secured $200 million in funding and plans to deliver its first litter of genetically enhanced puppies in early 2027.
datos: $200 million raised from investors including In‑Q‑Tel, Sequoia Capital and ARK Invest
Warhound aims to produce the first batch of puppies in early 2027
The startup will focus on Belgian Malinois, Labrador Retrievers and German Shepherds
David Spirk, former DoD chief data officer and ex‑Palantir executive, is serving as chief executive
The company plans to eliminate hip dysplasia through gene editing
Palmer Luckey and Ben Lamm have been working on the project for over a year and will not hold day‑to‑day roles; Luckey holds no equity
articles.conclusion: If successful, Warhound could reduce reliance on European breeders and provide the military with healthier, more capable canine units, but the program also raises ethical and regulatory questions about genetically modifying working animals.

articles.title: Autopsia del verano más mortífero en Europa: 50.000 fallecidos por calor
articles.que_paso: Una investigación ha estimado que alrededor de 50.000 personas murieron por exceso de calor durante el verano más letal registrado en Europa, afectando a 854 áreas urbanas y atribuyendo la mayor parte de esas muertes al cambio climático antropogénico.
datos: ≈50.000 fallecimientos por calor en el verano más mortífero de Europa
65 % de esas muertes vinculadas al cambio climático causado por el ser humano
854 áreas urbanas europeas incluidas en el cálculo
El estudio se centra en el verano más letal de la historia reciente del continente
articles.conclusion: El hallazgo subraya la urgencia de políticas de adaptación y mitigación climática para proteger a la población urbana de eventos de calor extremo.

articles.title: The next-gen Xbox won’t cost you $1,800. It can’t. Can it?
articles.que_paso: Fortune reported that Microsoft’s next‑generation console, internally codenamed Helix, is projected to cost between $1,200 and $1,800 when it launches in 2028, sparking debate about whether Microsoft will continue subsidizing hardware as it did with previous Xbox models.
datos: The internal cost projection for the Helix console is $1,200‑$1,800 per unit (Fortune, 2026).
Microsoft reportedly spent $1.5 billion to subsidize the Xbox Series X and Series S to retail at $499 and $299 respectively (The Verge, 2021).
Microsoft’s internal memo cited $20 billion in content, platform, and hardware subsidies over the past five years (internal “Xbox reset” memo, 2025).
Former Xbox exec Mike Ybarra said, “I wouldn’t release it at all,” referring to the projected price (quoted in Fortune article).
Former Xbox president Sarah Bond described the Helix as “a very premium, very high‑end curated experience” in 2024.
CEO Satya Nadella stated on the Hard Fork podcast that Microsoft must turn its hardware strategy into a sustainable business (podcast, 2025).
articles.conclusion: If the Helix’s price remains high, Microsoft may need to abandon its historic subsidy model, shifting revenue reliance to Game Pass and services, which could affect budgeting for enterprises planning to adopt the platform.

articles.title: New York City Passes Horse Carriage Ban, Ending a Central Park Tradition
articles.que_paso: After a passenger was killed in a horse‑drawn carriage accident in June, the New York City Council voted to prohibit the carriage service in Central Park. The legislation is slated to take effect in 2028, though city officials anticipate a legal challenge.
datos: The fatal accident occurred in June 2026, involving a passenger in a horse‑drawn carriage.
The New York City Council approved the ban on horse carriage rides in Central Park.
The ban is scheduled to become law in 2028.
City officials have warned that the ban will likely be contested in court.
Horse‑drawn carriage rides have been a Central Park tradition for over a century.
The legislation was introduced in response to safety concerns following the June death.
articles.conclusion: The ban removes a historic tourist attraction and signals stricter safety regulation, while the expected lawsuit could delay its enforcement and affect city revenue from carriage permits.

articles.title: What to Know About Shamonda Virus Following the First Reported Human Infection
articles.que_paso: France confirmed that a severely immunocompromised patient in Lyon died earlier this month after contracting the Shamonda virus, a pathogen previously thought unable to infect humans. The infection is believed to have come from a biting midge, and authorities stress the case is exceptional while continuing investigations. The report also notes the emergence of a European variant in livestock across several countries.
datos: France confirmed the death of the first human case of Shamonda virus in Lyon earlier this month.
The patient was severely immunocompromised and likely contracted the virus via a biting midge bite.
Shamonda virus was first identified in Nigeria in the mid‑1960s and has been reported in livestock across Africa and Japan.
A new variant, Shamonda‑Europe, was detected in Swiss livestock this summer and later in multiple European countries including Spain.
Spain’s Ministry reported two distinct strains (Type 1 and Type 2) present on farms in 37 French provinces as of early September.
No vaccine exists; prevention relies on insecticides and repellents, and the French government states there is no risk to the general public.
articles.conclusion: The case highlights a potential zoonotic spillover that warrants heightened surveillance of livestock and vector control, but the immediate public health risk remains low for the general population.

articles.title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
articles.que_paso: In a Phase 3 trial, Moderna and Merck tested a personalized mRNA vaccine (intismeran) combined with Keytruda in patients with surgically removed stage IIB‑IV melanoma, and reported a 42 % lower risk of death or recurrence compared with Keytruda alone. The top‑line results were released early after an embargo breach and will be presented at the European Society of Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid.
datos: The trial enrolled 1,137 patients with stage IIB‑IV melanoma.
Participants were randomized in a 2:1 ratio to receive intismeran‑Keytruda or Keytruda plus placebo.
After two years, recurrence‑free survival was 82 % in the vaccine arm versus 70 % in the control arm.
The vaccine, intismeran (mRNA‑4157), encodes up to 34 patient‑specific tumor mutations.
The data have been accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine.
Results were disclosed at the European Society of Medical Oncology conference in Madrid, Spain.
articles.conclusion: The outcome demonstrates that personalized mRNA therapy can substantially improve melanoma survival, suggesting a near‑term regulatory pathway and a new benchmark for cancer‑treatment strategies.

articles.title: Latest estimate for Starship launches required to support a Moon landing? 22.
articles.que_paso: NASA’s Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel cited an estimate of roughly 22 Starship launches needed to refuel a lunar lander in low‑Earth orbit for Artemis IV, while SpaceX’s Elon Musk argued the figure should be closer to 6‑8. Earlier NASA officials had only given vague ranges, and Blue Origin’s competing lander does not rely on orbital refueling.
datos: In 2023, Lisa Watson‑Morgan, then director of NASA’s Human Landing System, said the launch requirement was “high single digits to low double digits.”
Charlie Precourt, a panel member, stated the latest estimate is around 22 refueling flights for Artemis IV.
Elon Musk replied on X that the actual number will be “more like 6 to 8.”
Blue Origin’s Blue Moon lander design will not use orbital refueling for its initial mission.
The earlier estimate assumed one “depot” Starship plus 11 tanker Starships to fully load the lunar lander.
NASA has repeatedly said it does not have a definitive launch count and will not disclose a precise number.
articles.conclusion: If the true launch requirement is near the lower end, Starship could become a cost‑effective element of Artemis; a higher count would strain schedules and budgets, affecting the program’s feasibility.

articles.title: Sharp drops for AI stocks overwhelm markets worldwide as oil prices jump
articles.que_paso: AI‑related equities plunged on Thursday, dragging US indexes lower while oil prices surged on geopolitical tension with Iran.
datos: S&P 500 fell 1.2%, its worst day since July 2026
Nasdaq composite dropped 2.6%
Nvidia shares slid 4.4% pulling the S&P down
Lam Research stock tumbled 11.8% despite earnings beat
Brent crude rose 4% to $113.17 per barrel, up from under $97 at the start of October
CoreWeave shares fell 10.1% amid debt concerns
articles.conclusion: The sell‑off shows that high financing costs for AI infrastructure can quickly erode market confidence, and rising energy prices add further cost pressure for operations planning.

articles.title: Dead7’s New Track “Feels Like” Arrives Online
articles.que_paso: dead7 released an online visualizer for their new alternative‑metal track “Feels Like.” The band, signed to SharpTone Records, included a statement from vocalist Jason Kozik about the song’s theme of personal happiness.
datos: Track title: “Feels Like.”
Band: dead7, an alternative metal group.
Label: SharpTone Records.
Vocalist: Jason Kozik, who provided a quote on the song’s theme.
The visualizer for the track is available for streaming online.
articles.conclusion: The release shows how niche metal acts leverage visual content and personal‑growth messaging to engage fans, a tactic that can be replicated in other niche markets.

articles.title: Trump Goes to Iowa, Hoping to Stop Farmers From Voting Blue
articles.que_paso: President Donald Trump held a campaign event in Iowa, using the appearance to promote an $8 billion aid package for farmers hit by high diesel prices. The stop occurs as Iowa’s traditionally Republican electorate faces competitive Democratic bids for the governor’s mansion, a U.S. Senate seat, and multiple House districts, and as the Iowa Farmers Union has thrown its support behind the entire Democratic congressional slate.
datos: Trump promoted an $8 billion economic aid package for farmers affected by high diesel prices
The Iowa Farmers Union publicly endorsed the entire Democratic congressional slate
Democrats are targeting the Iowa governor’s mansion, a U.S. Senate seat, and two House seats in the upcoming election
The Iowa event is part of a weeklong campaign tour across several red states that were considered non‑competitive a few months earlier
Calley Means resigned from the administration after leading efforts to eliminate artificial food dyes, increase chemical disclosures, and ban soda from federal food assistance programs
articles.conclusion: The visit signals heightened political risk for the agricultural sector in Iowa, suggesting that policy shifts could affect farm operating costs and supply‑chain planning for businesses reliant on Midwestern production.

articles.title: What Is PHP? Why Are Government and Business Websites Going Offline?
articles.que_paso: A critical vulnerability was discovered in PHP, the scripting language that powers the majority of web sites, leading developers, IT teams, and public agencies worldwide to scramble to apply emergency patches. The issue caused many government and corporate portals to become temporarily inaccessible while fixes were rolled out.
datos: The flaw resides in PHP, the programming language that underpins much of the web
The vulnerability is described as critical in severity
A global effort to patch vulnerable systems was launched immediately after discovery
Government and business websites experienced downtime as a direct result of the flaw
articles.conclusion: Rapid remediation is essential to restore service continuity and protect data, highlighting the need for proactive vulnerability management in core web technologies.

articles.title: Sánchez defiende que Begoña Gómez dejó su trabajo cuando llegó a Moncloa y niega que pueda ejercer influencia
articles.que_paso: Pedro Sánchez respondió a críticas sobre posible nepotismo, asegurando que su esposa, Begoña Gómez, abandonó su puesto laboral al iniciar su mandato en la Moncloa. Además, negó que ella pueda ejercer influencia alguna por ser la cónyuge del presidente.
datos: Pedro Sánchez es el presidente del Gobierno de España.
Begoña Gómez es la esposa de Pedro Sánchez.
Begoña Gómez dejó su empleo cuando Sánchez llegó a la Moncloa.
Sánchez declaró que su esposa no ejerce influencia por su condición de cónyuge.
La Moncloa es la residencia oficial del presidente de España.
articles.conclusion: La defensa busca disipar sospechas de nepotismo y reforzar la imagen de independencia en la gestión del gobierno.

articles.title: Comcast loses more customers, claims other ISPs' cheap prices are "irrational"
articles.que_paso: Comcast announced that its residential broadband base shrank sharply in the third quarter of 2026, prompting the company to launch a large‑scale restructuring that includes job cuts and a multibillion‑dollar cost‑transformation plan. The losses are attributed to aggressive low‑price offers from fiber rivals, which the firm says are financially unsustainable. Executives framed the changes as a response to shifting competition and the need to modernize the business.
datos: Comcast lost 144,000 residential broadband customers in Q3 2026, compared with a 91,000‑customer loss in Q3 2025
Comcast now serves 28.3 million residential broadband customers in the United States
CFO Jason Armstrong cited $30‑$40 per month broadband offers from fiber operators as “irrational pricing” in specific markets during the third quarter
Deploying fiber is said to cost $1,500 or more per home, according to Armstrong
Comcast expects a “significant charge” of over $1 billion to appear in its fourth‑quarter earnings report
articles.conclusion: The data signals mounting pressure on legacy cable providers to curb churn and control costs, while the planned restructuring and AI‑driven service model could reshape Comcast’s workforce and competitive stance.

articles.title: Trump defiende el polémico anuncio electoral de Ramaswamy contra la demócrata Acton en Ohio
articles.que_paso: Vivek Ramaswamy lanzó un anuncio de campaña que muestra a la madre de Amy Acton llamándola “mentirosa”. El gobernador republicano de Ohio, Mike DeWine, pidió que se retire, mientras Donald Trump y J.D. Vance apoyaron su permanencia. La polémica ha intensificado la disputa electoral entre Ramaswamy y Acton.
datos: Ramaswamy es el candidato republicano a gobernador de Ohio
Amy Acton, de 60 años, fue directora del Departamento de Salud de Ohio bajo DeWine
El anuncio incluye a Donna Arthur, madre de Acton, acusando a su hija de mentir sobre su infancia
Mike DeWine solicitó el jueves retirar el anuncio, calificándolo de “profundamente preocupante”
Donald Trump, en Truth, instó a Ramaswamy a mantener el anuncio y criticó a la prensa
Acton reveló que entre los 10 y 12 años sufrió abusos sexuales por el marido de su madre, quien fue arrestado y acusado de violación en 1978 y declarado prófugo
articles.conclusion: El conflicto muestra cómo los ataques personales pueden desestabilizar campañas y dividir al partido, lo que podría afectar la competitividad de Ramaswamy y la posibilidad de que Acton se convierta en la primera gobernadora demócrata de Ohio en veinte años.

articles.title: La mansión que perteneció a Juan Gabriel en Florida vuelve al mercado por 38,9 millones de dólares
articles.que_paso: Tras la venta en 2022, la antigua residencia de Juan Gabriel en Southwest Ranches, Florida, ha sido remodelada y vuelve a ofertarse por 38,9 millones de dólares, con un amplio complejo de lujo que incluye varias construcciones y amenidades deportivas y recreativas.
datos: La propiedad fue comprada por Juan Gabriel en 1995.
En 2022 la familia vendió la mansión por 9 millones de dólares a un comprador no identificado.
El terreno abarca casi cuatro hectáreas y contiene seis edificaciones, incluida la casa principal de cinco habitaciones.
La cochera climatizada tiene 185 metros cuadrados.
El precio de venta solicitado es de 38,9 millones de dólares.
La agente inmobiliaria Angeline Earnest describió la casa como “un destino vacacional”.
articles.conclusion: El incremento del precio muestra la fuerte demanda de propiedades de lujo en el sur de Florida y sugiere que inversiones en remodelaciones pueden multiplicar significativamente el valor de activos inmobiliarios.

articles.title: Imminence Share “Crestfallen” Performance From Ystads Theater
articles.que_paso: Swedish metalcore band Imminence posted a new video of their song “Crestfallen” performed live at Ystads Theater in Ystad, continuing a series of intimate theater shows. The release follows their recent album launch and maintains the pattern of adding a string quartet to the performances.
datos: Imminence is a Swedish melodic metalcore outfit.
The live video features the song “Crestfallen” from the album “Axis Mundi”.
“Axis Mundi” was released on October 2, 2026 through Sumerian Records.
The performance was recorded at Ystads Theater in Ystad, Sweden.
Previous Ystads Theater shows have frequently included a string quartet.
articles.conclusion: The band’s focus on intimate, string‑enhanced live videos reinforces their artistic brand and can drive deeper fan engagement and streaming activity.

articles.title: Muere Tom Skerritt, actor de 'Top Gun' y 'Alien', a los 93 años
articles.que_paso: El actor Tom Skerritt falleció a los 93 años y su familia confirmó su muerte mediante un comunicado publicado en The Hollywood Reporter. Con una carrera que abarcó desde su debut en 1962 hasta papeles icónicos en M*A*S*H, Alien y Top Gun, su partida deja un vacío en el cine y la televisión.
datos: Falleció el 22 de octubre de 2026 a los 93 años.
Nació el 25 de agosto de 1933 en Detroit, Michigan, EE. UU.
Se incorporó a la Fuerza Aérea de EE. UU. en 1951 antes de iniciar su carrera actoral.
Debutó en la gran pantalla en 1962 con la película War Hunt junto a Robert Redford y Sydney Pollack.
Ganó un Emmy en 1993 como mejor actor principal en drama por su papel en Picket Fences.
Le sobreviven su tercera esposa, Julie Tokashiki, y sus cinco hijos: Andy, Erin, Matt, Colin y Emiko.
articles.conclusion: Su muerte marca el fin de una trayectoria que influyó en generaciones de actores y espectadores, recordando la importancia de la versatilidad y el compromiso artístico en la industria del entretenimiento.

articles.title: HALF ME Launch Music Video Combining Three Tracks From Their New Album “Dogma”
articles.que_paso: German metalcore band HALF ME released a music video that merges three of the final tracks from their upcoming album “Dogma”, just hours before the album’s scheduled launch on October 23, 2026. The video was directed by Chris Hesse.
datos: Band: HALF ME (German metalcore)
Video combines three closing tracks: “Through Prayer”, “IV. Melancholia”, “Coup d‘Etat”
Director: Chris Hesse
Album “Dogma” release date: October 23, 2026 (hours after video)
Tracks are the final three songs on the album
articles.conclusion: Releasing the combined‑track video right before the album drop creates immediate engagement and gives listeners a cohesive preview of the album’s concluding narrative.

articles.title: The FCC is beginning to block gadgets with ‘foreign surveillance chips’
articles.que_paso: The FCC invoked its newly‑granted authority to block two consumer devices because they contain a HiVision Hi3516CV610 “foreign surveillance” chip tied to Huawei, marking the first use of this power since it was adopted on October 13. The agency did not identify the specific products and declined to comment when asked.
datos: On October 13, 2026 the FCC adopted a rule allowing it to block gadgets that contain chips from entities on its national‑security Covered List.
The chip cited is the HiVision Hi3516CV610 UHD Smart Vision System‑on‑Chip.
HiVision is a subsidiary of Huawei, which is listed on the FCC’s Covered List as a national‑security risk.
Listings on AliExpress show the chip sold as a package with a Sony camera sensor and sometimes an integrated lens.
The FCC has previously used similar authority to ban routers and Roomba vacuum cleaners.
The agency did not disclose which two devices were blocked and did not respond to a request for comment.
articles.conclusion: The move signals a broader FCC crackdown on supply‑chain risks, urging manufacturers and importers to verify component origins to avoid sudden market exclusions.

articles.title: Sílvia Munt revisita ‘Panorama desde el puente’, de Arthur Miller, potenciando a su principal personaje femenino
articles.que_paso: Se estrenó en Barcelona una nueva versión de "Panorama desde el puente" de Arthur Miller, dirigida por Sílvia Munt y puesta en escena en el Teatro Goya bajo la producción de Bitó. El montaje reúne a Laura Conejero, David Selvas, Laura Gaja y Jan D. Casablancas, y fue presentado con comentarios de Jordi González, vicepresidente de arte y contenidos de Focus, quien relacionó la obra con su propia historia familiar de emigración.
datos: "Panorama desde el puente" se estrenó originalmente en 1955
La traducción al catalán fue realizada por Joan Sellent
La puesta se presenta en el Teatro Goya de Barcelona, producción de Bitó
Sílvia Munt dirigió previamente "El precio (El preu)" en 2017
El elenco principal incluye a Laura Conejero (Beatrice), David Selvas (Eddie Carbone), Laura Gaja (Catherine) y Jan D. Casablancas (Rodolpho)
Jordi González, vicepresidente de arte y contenidos de Focus, es hijo de emigrantes que llegaron a Barcelona
articles.conclusion: El montaje subraya la vigencia de los conflictos migratorios y de poder en la sociedad actual, ofreciendo al público una reflexión directa sobre la naturaleza humana que trasciende épocas.

articles.title: Official Footage Of Agriculture’s 2026 ‘Roadburn’ Set Released
articles.que_paso: Agriculture’s full 2026 Roadburn performance has been uploaded to the internet, making the entire set publicly viewable. The Dutch festival appearance, originally recorded on April 18 in Tilburg, is now linked to the band’s recent live album release.
datos: Agriculture performed at Roadburn Festival on April 18, 2026 in Tilburg, Netherlands.
The performance was recorded for the live album “The Spiritual Sound, Live In Europe 2026”.
The live album was released earlier in October 2026 on the label The Flenser.
The video release was announced as the official footage of the entire set.
Roadburn is an annual festival that showcases extreme music genres.
articles.conclusion: The release gives fans immediate access to the band’s latest live material and may drive further sales and streaming of the new album.

articles.title: Stocks See Steepest Decline in Months Amid A.I. Worries
articles.que_paso: The S&P 500 dropped more than 1.4% and the Nasdaq fell about 2.5% in a single session, marking their worst one‑day losses since July and June respectively, as investor sentiment was rattled by concerns over artificial‑intelligence developments. The declines occurred on October 23, 2026, reflecting heightened market anxiety about AI‑related regulatory and valuation issues.
datos: S&P 500 fell >1.4% on Oct 23, 2026
Nasdaq fell ~2.5% on Oct 23, 2026
S&P 500’s last larger daily decline was in July 2026
Nasdaq’s last larger daily decline was in June 2026
Market anxiety linked to AI‑related regulatory and valuation concerns
articles.conclusion: The sharp pullback shows AI uncertainty can quickly trigger broad market sell‑offs, so managers should closely monitor AI policy and valuation risks when allocating to tech stocks.

articles.title: Tom Skerritt, estrella de ‘Alien’, ‘Top Gun’ y ‘MASH’, muere a los 93 años
articles.que_paso: El actor estadounidense Tom Skerritt falleció a los 93 años, poniendo fin a una trayectoria de más de sesenta años en cine y televisión, conocida por papeles en ‘Alien’, ‘Top Gun’ y la serie ‘MASH’. Su muerte se anunció el 23 de octubre de 2026.
datos: Tom Skerritt, nacido el 13 de agosto de 1933, murió el 23 de octubre de 2026.
Ganó un premio Emmy en 1993 por su papel protagónico en la serie ‘Picket Fences’.
Su carrera abarcó más de seis décadas, desde su debut en 1962 hasta su último proyecto en 2025.
Participó en películas icónicas como ‘Alien’ (1979), ‘Top Gun’ (1986) y la serie de televisión ‘MASH’ (1972‑1983).
Era ciudadano estadounidense y residía en Los Ángeles al momento de su fallecimiento.
articles.conclusion: Su fallecimiento cierra una era para el cine de ciencia ficción y acción, subrayando la relevancia de contar con actores versátiles que sostengan franquicias durante décadas.

articles.title: Leaked Mass Effect: Universe trailer gives a taste of what we're all missing
articles.que_paso: A two‑minute in‑engine trailer for the cancelled Mass Effect: Universe was leaked on Reddit, prompting verification by IGN and Bloomberg. The leak follows EA’s announcement that BioWare will close, ending work on the game that had been in early development by a small internal team.
datos: The trailer appeared on Reddit just before noon Eastern Time on October 22, 2026.
IGN and Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier confirmed the trailer’s authenticity within hours of the leak.
The leaked footage is described by its creators as “in‑engine footage from our small team” using pre‑production assets and runs about two minutes.
EA executives Cam Weber and David Tinson stated in an internal memo that only a small BioWare team was working on early development for Mass Effect.
Sci‑fi authors Catherynne M. Valente and Derek Kunsken, who had been involved for years, posted quotes expressing disappointment after the cancellation.
articles.conclusion: The leak confirms that substantive work existed beyond the public teaser, highlighting the scale of the project lost with BioWare’s shutdown and signaling potential brand and talent gaps for EA’s RPG portfolio.

articles.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom
articles.que_paso: Shoshana Berger, a former WIRED editor now working with Notion and IDEO, and Nina Willdorf launched the Aged Intelligence Society, an invite‑only dinner series that helps mid‑career women apply frontier AI tools to personal and professional challenges, aiming to boost fluency and cut administrative burdens.
datos: Shoshana Berger is a former WIRED editor and editorial leader for Notion and IDEO.
Nina Willdorf co‑founded the Aged Intelligence Society with Berger.
The Society hosts invite‑only dinner parties where participants bring laptops to work on a "midlife quandary" using AI tools.
Each event includes a 15‑minute segment called "library time" for testing AI solutions.
Berger and Willdorf said they took beta blockers and ashwagandha before events.
They referenced using the AI model Claude during discussions.
articles.conclusion: The initiative demonstrates a practical pathway for women in midlife to acquire AI competence, addressing a talent gap and showing how targeted community events can translate emerging technology into everyday productivity gains.

articles.title: Unsealed O.J. Simpson Records Prompt a Request for a New Investigation
articles.que_paso: Tanya Brown publicly alleged that someone assisted O.J. Simpson in disposing of the murder weapon, and a former Simpson attorney has formally requested the appointment of a special prosecutor after new records were unsealed. The request seeks to reopen the investigation into the 1994‑1995 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman.
datos: "I believe someone helped O.J. Simpson get rid of the murder weapon," said Tanya Brown.
A former lawyer for O.J. Simpson filed a written request for a special prosecutor.
The request follows the recent unsealing of previously confidential Simpson case records.
The records relate to the 1994‑1995 criminal trial for the murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman.
No law enforcement agency has confirmed a response to the special prosecutor request as of the article date.
articles.conclusion: If a special prosecutor is appointed, the case could be reopened, potentially altering legal outcomes and public perception of the original verdict.

articles.title: Putin ignora las propuestas de Zelenski sobre el Donbás porque el este de Ucrania es "territorio ruso"
articles.que_paso: El presidente ruso desestimó las propuestas de paz de Zelenski para el Donbás, argumentando que el este de Ucrania pertenece a Rusia y que rusos y ucranianos son genéticamente idénticos, al tiempo que calificó de "esquizofrenia" las advertencias europeas sobre un posible conflicto directo.
datos: Putin afirmó que rusos y ucranianos son "genéticamente" iguales
Llamó "esquizofrenia" a los avisos de Europa sobre un conflicto directo
Ignoró las propuestas de Zelenski para el Donbás
Declaró que el este de Ucrania es "territorio ruso"
articles.conclusion: Esta postura refuerza la posición intransigente de Rusia y complica cualquier avance diplomático, lo que implica que los negociadores occidentales deberán ajustar sus estrategias ante una mayor retórica de soberanía rusa.

articles.title: Ink droplets in motion snag top prize in Nikon Small World contest
articles.que_paso: Ole Bielfeldt, a 25‑year‑old German experimental photographer, captured an image of ink droplets being deposited by an inkjet printer and was awarded the top prize in the 2026 Nikon Small World photomicrography competition, beating 1,802 other submissions from 69 countries. He achieved the shot by modifying the printer so the paper moved under a stationary printhead and using a flash in a dark room to freeze the droplets, a technique he devised without AI or expensive equipment.
datos: Ole Bielfeldt is a 25‑year‑old photographer from Germany.
The 2026 Nikon Small World competition received 1,802 entries representing 69 countries.
Bielfeldt built a custom microscope adaptor from a tube and wood to attach his father’s camera.
He froze the ink droplets by deconstructing the printer, moving the paper under a stationary printhead, and using a flash as the shutter in a dark room.
Nikon Small World was founded in 1974 and celebrated its 52nd anniversary in 2026.
Nikon will publish a full‑color 2027 calendar featuring the 2026 winners.
articles.conclusion: The win demonstrates that low‑cost, hands‑on engineering can outperform high‑tech solutions in scientific imaging, highlighting the operational value of creative problem‑solving and DIY innovation.

articles.title: Mortgage Rates Remain Above 7%, Pushing Home Prices Lower in Some Areas
articles.que_paso: Mortgage rates edged down to 7.32 % for a 30‑year fixed loan, but they remain above the 7 % threshold that many buyers consider affordable. At the same time, home prices are beginning to fall in several regional markets, reflecting the strain on demand.
datos: The average 30‑year fixed mortgage rate is 7.32 %.
The rate dropped slightly from the previous reporting period.
Prospective home buyers are reporting affordability challenges.
Home prices are starting to decline in certain areas.
The figures were reported on October 23 2026.
articles.conclusion: Sustained high borrowing costs will keep demand suppressed, so any price declines may be short‑lived and inventory could stay limited, affecting acquisition timing and cash‑flow planning.

articles.title: Miles de mujeres protestan en Polonia por el derecho al aborto y contra el Gobierno de Tusk: “Estamos hartas de promesas”
articles.que_paso: Miles de mujeres y simpatizantes se congregaron este jueves en varias ciudades de Polonia, entre ellas Cracovia, para exigir la liberalización del aborto y criticar al gobierno de Donald Tusk, mientras se debate la posible aplicación de un veto presidencial a dos proyectos de ley aprobados recientemente por la Cámara Baja. La movilización se produce en el contexto de un intento fallido en 2024 de despenalizar la ayuda al aborto y de la presión sobre una coalición que apenas ha avanzado en la reforma legislativa.
datos: Miles de manifestantes se reunieron en decenas de ciudades polacas el 23 de octubre de 2026.
La protesta coincidió con el sexto aniversario de la sentencia del Tribunal Constitucional del 22 de octubre de 2020 que eliminó la excepción por malformación fetal.
En julio de 2024, un intento de despenalizar la ayuda al aborto fracasó en la Cámara Baja.

Esta semana la Cámara Baja aprobó dos proyectos de ley: uno que restablece la interrupción por anomalías fetales graves y otro que despenaliza parcialmente el auxilio al aborto, eliminando penas de hasta tres años de cárcel.
Donald Tusk, primer ministro, lidera la Coalición Ciudadana, que tiene mayoría en la Cámara Baja.
articles.conclusion: La presión social evidencia que la agenda de liberalización del aborto es un punto crítico para la estabilidad de la coalición de Tusk, y la posible intervención presidencial podría definir el futuro del derecho al aborto en Polonia.

articles.title: CEOE rectifica y no impugnará finalmente la huelga general por la vivienda antes del 11 de noviembre
articles.que_paso: La Confederación Española de Organizaciones Empresariales (CEOE) ha revocado su intención de acudir a los tribunales para impugnar la huelga general prevista sobre la vivienda, que se celebrará antes del 11 de noviembre, pese a haber anunciado previamente que lo haría.
datos: CEOE es la principal patronal empresarial de España
La decisión es no impugnar judicialmente la huelga
La huelga está programada para celebrarse antes del 11 de noviembre de 2026
El motivo de la huelga es la crisis de la vivienda
En comunicados anteriores la CEOE había anticipado que presentaría recursos legales contra el paro
articles.conclusion: Esta rectificación reduce la tensión legal entre empleadores y sindicatos y sugiere que la negociación sobre la vivienda podría abordarse directamente sin intervención judicial.

articles.title: Bryan Johnson Announces Plans for Mass Revenge
articles.que_paso: Bryan Johnson, a multimillion‑dollar longevity entrepreneur, posted on X that an AI agent would collect every negative comment about him, map each critic’s contacts and email their extended networks, then later said the threat was a joke.
datos: Bryan Johnson was recently diagnosed with an incurable autoimmune disease.
He announced the AI‑driven email retaliation in a post on X (formerly Twitter) in the week of October 2026.
The post attracted over 3.4 million views and thousands of comments.
Johnson said the AI would log every negative comment, create a profile, map social connections and send an email blast to each person’s extended network.
In a follow‑up X post, Johnson retracted the threat, stating he was “just kidding.”
articles.conclusion: The episode shows how ultra‑wealthy tech figures can mobilize AI and massive online reach to intimidate critics, underscoring a tangible risk of weaponized personal data even when framed as a joke.

articles.title: Una simple foto del rostro puede dar pistas sobre la supervivencia de un paciente con cáncer. Esta IA busca encontrarlas
articles.que_paso: Un equipo de investigadores ha desarrollado una IA llamada FAHR‑Face que, a partir de una foto del rostro, estima la edad biológica y el riesgo de mortalidad de pacientes con cáncer, con el objetivo de ayudar a los oncólogos a elegir tratamientos más adecuados. El sistema se entrenó y validó con grandes bases de datos de imágenes para comprobar su capacidad predictiva.
datos: El modelo base se entrenó con más de 40 000 000 de fotografías faciales.
Posteriormente se afinó con 34 363 imágenes de pacientes oncológicos.
Se validó en una cohorte independiente de aproximadamente 5 000 pacientes.
Los pacientes clasificados en el cuartil de mayor riesgo tenían un riesgo de mortalidad 3,23 veces superior al del cuartil de menor riesgo.
De 122 pacientes de alto riesgo, el 52,5 % falleció dentro de los 90 días posteriores.
Los datos provienen mayoritariamente de cohortes de pacientes blancos, lo que limita la generalización del modelo.
articles.conclusion: Si la IA confirma su precisión, podría proporcionar a los oncólogos una herramienta objetiva para priorizar tratamientos, aunque su uso debe acompañarse de cautela por sesgos demográficos y la falta de datos sobre toxicidad.

articles.title: Samsung all but confirms iPhone Duo is goosing Galaxy Z8 sales
articles.que_paso: Samsung confirmed that its 2026 European foldable lineup is selling significantly better after Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo, with sales and online interest for the larger Z Fold models jumping sharply, while the smaller Z Flip line remains flat.
datos: Combined European sales of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Z Fold 8 Ultra are up 45 % versus the Galaxy Z Fold 7.
Search volume for the Z8 series across Europe rose 460 % during the week of 6–12 September 2026.
The iPhone Duo was announced on 9 September 2026.
Z Fold 8 search volume across September 2026 increased 260 %.
US pre‑order activity for the Galaxy Z8 series was 30 % higher than in the same period last year.
Samsung’s larger foldables accounted for about 80 % of all foldable phone purchases prior to this period.
articles.conclusion: Apple’s entry into foldables is directly boosting demand for Samsung’s larger models, signalling a market shift toward premium, wide‑screen foldable devices and prompting Samsung to accelerate its product strategy.

articles.title: Los astrónomo han hecho la mejor radiografía hasta el momento de los 5 primeros minutos del Universo
articles.que_paso: Un equipo de la Universidad de Minnesota analizó 15 galaxias diminutas y con metalicidad extremadamente baja usando los espectrógrafos MODS de la Universidad Estatal de Ohio, con el objetivo de medir el helio primordial. Gracias a esa observación lograron determinar la abundancia de helio en los primeros cinco minutos del Universo con una incertidumbre del 0,5 %.
datos: Investigadores de la Universidad de Minnesota lideraron el estudio.
Utilizaron los espectrógrafos MODS, desarrollados en la Universidad Estatal de Ohio.
Seleccionaron 15 galaxias pequeñas con metalicidad muy baja.
Detectaron 10 líneas espectrales de helio y 15 de hidrógeno.
Obtuvieron una medida de helio primordial del 25 % con una incertidumbre del 0,5 %.
articles.conclusion: Esta precisión reduce significativamente la incertidumbre en la nucleosíntesis del Big Bang, ofreciendo a los modelos cosmológicos datos más fiables para validar teorías sobre los primeros minutos del Universo.

articles.title: La prefectura de París prolonga hasta el lunes el toque de queda en zonas del centro de la capital
articles.que_paso: La Prefectura de Policía de París decidió extender el toque de queda vigente en áreas centrales, de modo que permanecerá en vigor hasta la mañana del lunes, manteniendo el horario nocturno habitual. La decisión se tomó sin especificar causas adicionales.
datos: La autoridad emisora es la Prefectura de Policía de París
El toque de queda se extiende hasta el lunes por la mañana
El horario del toque de queda es de 23:00 a 06:00 horas
La medida afecta a zonas del centro de la capital francesa
articles.conclusion: Esta extensión prolonga las restricciones de movilidad nocturna en el corazón de París, obligando a ajustar la planificación operativa y de seguridad para los próximos días.

articles.title: Why Many Voters Are Unhappy With the Economy
articles.que_paso: As the upcoming midterm elections draw near, voters are expressing significant dissatisfaction with the state of the economy. Chief economic correspondent Ben Casselman is reporting on the specific economic issues that are driving this frustration.
datos: Midterm elections are approaching
The economy is a top concern for voters
Ben Casselman is the chief economic correspondent
The article aims to describe which economic aspects frustrate voters
The article is titled "Why Many Voters Are Unhappy With the Economy"
articles.conclusion: Voter anxiety about the economy could sway the midterm results, so candidates and policymakers need to address economic grievances promptly.

articles.title: EE UU desmantela un negocio millonario de fraude matrimonial: 40.000 dólares por una pareja y la promesa de una ‘green card’
articles.que_paso: El Departamento de Justicia de EE. UU. desmanteló una organización que vendía matrimonios falsos a extranjeros, cobrando 40.000 dólares por pareja y facilitando entre 18 y 20 uniones al año, bajo la promesa de obtener una tarjeta verde. La operación se cerró tras una investigación federal que reveló el esquema de fraude matrimonial.
datos: El negocio cobraba 40.000 dólares a cada pareja.
Se celebraron entre 18 y 20 matrimonios falsos al año.
Los ingresos totales estimados fueron alrededor de seis millones de dólares.
La operación fue investigada y cerrada por el Departamento de Justicia de EE. UU.
El objetivo era ofrecer la ‘green card’ mediante matrimonios fraudulentos.
articles.conclusion: El caso muestra la vulnerabilidad de los procesos de inmigración a esquemas lucrativos y subraya la necesidad de sistemas de detección automatizada para prevenir fraudes similares.

articles.title: El thriller de espías que tiene un 100% de críticas positivas en Rotten Tomatoes ya tiene su sexta temporada completa en Apple TV+
articles.que_paso: La sexta temporada de la serie de espionaje 'Slow Horses' concluyó en Apple TV+ y recibió una valoración perfecta en Rotten Tomatoes. La trama sigue a agentes descartados del MI5 que, pese a sus errores, siguen involucrados en misiones críticas para la seguridad nacional. La producción anunció la confirmación de dos temporadas adicionales tras el cliffhanger final.
datos: 100 % de críticas positivas en Rotten Tomatoes
Media del 98 % en Rotten Tomatoes
Puntuación de 8,4 en IMDB
Emisión de la sexta temporada iniciada el 16 de septiembre de 2026
Emisión del sexto episodio el 21 de octubre de 2026
Se confirmaron dos temporadas más después de la sexta
articles.conclusion: El éxito crítico sugiere que la serie se ha convertido en un referente de calidad en el género, lo que justifica la inversión en nuevas temporadas y la atención de audiencias exigentes.

articles.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7 sacude el Tíbet
articles.que_paso: Un sismo de magnitud 7 golpeó una zona montañosa del Tíbet, provocando heridos y daños en viviendas. Además, se registra como el temblor más fuerte desde enero de 2024 en esa región.
datos: Magnitud del sismo: 7
Registrado como el temblor más potente desde enero 2024 en la zona
Causó heridos en la población local
Dejó daños estructurales en viviendas
Ocurrió en una región montañosa del Tíbet
articles.conclusion: El evento muestra la vulnerabilidad de infraestructuras en áreas remotas, lo que obliga a reforzar planes de contingencia y logística para operaciones en zonas sísmicamente activas.

articles.title: Trump acusa a Irán de encarecer el petróleo para dañar las aspiraciones republicanas en las legislativas
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump declaró que Irán estaría inflando el precio del crudo para perjudicar al Partido Republicano de cara a las elecciones legislativas del 3 de noviembre, señalando la manipulación del mercado como estrategia electoral.
datos: La acusación se realizó el jueves 23 de octubre de 2026.
Trump es el presidente de Estados Unidos según el artículo.
Irán es señalado como responsable del aumento del precio del petróleo.
Las elecciones legislativas están programadas para el 3 de noviembre de 2026.
El precio del petróleo ha subido, aunque el artículo no indica cifras exactas.
articles.conclusion: Si la acusación es cierta, la manipulación del precio del petróleo podría influir en la percepción pública y afectar los resultados electorales, obligando a los partidos a considerar la seguridad energética como factor estratégico.

articles.title: Los agentes de IA ya se mueven por cuentas bancarias y algunas entidades de EEUU se preparan para lo peor
articles.que_paso: Los clientes están autorizando a agentes de inteligencia artificial a usar sus credenciales para operar en sus cuentas bancarias, y los principales bancos de EE.UU. están empezando a bloquear o restringir ese tipo de acceso. JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citi y Wells Fargo han anunciado medidas para limitar la interacción de agentes externos con sus plataformas, mientras que la industria debate cómo identificar si una acción proviene de un humano o de una IA.
datos: JPMorgan afirma que bloquea, cuando puede, servicios que funcionan mediante intercambio de credenciales considerado inseguro
Morgan Stanley ha empezado a bloquear agentes de terceros según Axios
Bank of America y Citi también están imponiendo restricciones al acceso de agentes de IA
Wells Fargo incorporó cláusulas sobre agentes de IA en sus condiciones que entrarán en vigor el 24 de noviembre
Los agentes pueden ejecutar compras o mover fondos, lo que genera riesgo de acciones financieras reales si interpretan mal una instrucción
Los bancos indican que sus sistemas no siempre pueden distinguir la actividad humana de la ejecutada por una herramienta de IA
articles.conclusion: Esto obliga a las entidades financieras a replantear sus controles de acceso y a desarrollar protocolos de "día después" para mitigar riesgos de transacciones no autorizadas y de responsabilidad legal.

articles.title: Trump Ties Disaster Aid to Votes as Midterm Fight Heats Up
articles.que_paso: President Trump and Vice President JD Vance used campaign rallies to promise FEMA disaster assistance to states that have recently suffered natural catastrophes. The overt connection between federal aid and electoral support comes as the 2026 midterm elections intensify.
datos: President Trump is mentioned as offering FEMA money
Vice President JD Vance is mentioned alongside Trump
FEMA money is being dangled to disaster‑struck states
The offers were made during recent campaign rallies
The actions are occurring as the midterm election fight intensifies
articles.conclusion: Linking disaster aid to electoral support risks politicizing emergency relief and could influence voter behavior in the upcoming midterms.

articles.title: The Guardian view on AI safety: the push for global regulation must advance | Editorial
articles.que_paso: On Thursday, global tech groups rushed to patch critical PHP vulnerabilities that could let attackers seize servers, a flaw uncovered with AI assistance but also exploitable by AI tools. The episode coincided with two AI‑driven cyber‑attacks this year—one on an Australian health department site and another on Hugging Face—prompting UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan to warn of an imminent UK breach, while the US administration under Donald Trump continues to reject international AI regulation.
datos: The PHP flaws were publicly disclosed on Thursday, prompting immediate offline precautions on several websites.
Amazon reported detecting an exploitation attempt before the PHP vulnerability was made public.
OpenAI’s models were linked to two hacks in 2026: a breach of an Australian health department website and a swarm of AI bots targeting Hugging Face.
Kanishka Narayan, UK AI minister, warned that a similar cyber‑attack on the UK is "likely, if not inevitable".
Andy Burnham announced that AI will be the top agenda item during the UK’s G20 presidency in the first half of 2027.
President Donald Trump publicly dismissed calls for international AI regulation, stating "Whoever wins AI, wins."
articles.conclusion: The convergence of AI‑enabled security flaws and political resistance to regulation heightens operational risk, underscoring the need for robust, independent cyber safeguards and proactive compliance planning.

articles.title: La cotización del gas natural en Europa rompe nuevos máximos desde finales de 2022
articles.que_paso: El precio del gas natural TTF en el mercado holandés superó los 91 euros/MWh, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde diciembre de 2022, y provocó una caída de más del 2% en el Ibex español. La subida se produce en medio de la crisis energética derivada de la invasión rusa a Ucrania y el aumento de tensiones en Oriente Medio, que elevan la preocupación por el suministro invernal.
datos: A las 15:18 h (13:18 GMT) el TTF cotizó 91,416 €/MWh, un repunte del 4,8 % respecto al cierre del miércoles
A las 18:30 h (16:30 GMT) el precio era 90,885 €/MWh, un avance del 4,46 %
En la jornada el Ibex español perdió más del 2 % de su valor
En el acumulado del año el precio del gas natural en Europa subió más del 220 %
Desde el estallido del conflicto en Oriente Medio la revalorización supera el 185 %
Los inventarios europeos están alrededor del 75 % de su capacidad, considerado excepcionalmente bajo para esta época del año
articles.conclusion: Este nivel de precios eleva los costos operativos y la vulnerabilidad ante interrupciones de suministro, lo que obliga a los gestores a reforzar estrategias de cobertura y diversificación energética.

articles.title: A Young Family in Niagara, N.Y., and a Backyard Full of Radioactive Waste
articles.que_paso: A young family that moved to a suburban property near a creek in Niagara, New York, discovered that their backyard contained radioactive waste. When the contamination was reported, officials in hazmat suits arrived to assess and secure the site.
datos: The incident is located in Niagara, New York.
The occupants are a young family.
The waste found in the backyard is radioactive.
The property is adjacent to a creek.
Officials arrived wearing hazmat suits.
The situation is compared to the historic Love Canal disaster.
articles.conclusion: The case shows that legacy environmental hazards can still surface in new residential areas, emphasizing the importance of rigorous site investigations before development.

articles.title: PHP: Pretty Huge Problem with the internet – The Latest
articles.que_paso: A critical vulnerability in the PHP programming language has caused widespread website outages worldwide. Governments, businesses, and cybersecurity firms are racing to patch the flaw while hackers launch attacks to steal data and seize control of servers.
datos: Websites around the world have been taken offline due to the PHP flaw.
Governments and businesses are scrambling to fix the vulnerability.
Cybersecurity companies report millions of attack attempts since the issue was disclosed.
The vulnerability could allow hackers to steal data, take control of web servers, and disrupt services.
Michael Safi interviewed global technology reporter Aisha Down in a YouTube video.
articles.conclusion: The PHP flaw jeopardizes the stability of a large portion of the internet, making rapid remediation essential to protect data and maintain service continuity.

articles.title: El coqueteo de Trump con Putin incomoda a los candidatos republicanos en la recta final de las ‘midterms’
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump respaldó al enviado especial que calificó a Vladimir Putin de “humanitario” y anunció la eliminación de sanciones a Moscú con el objetivo de abaratar el diésel, lo que ha generado incomodidad entre varios candidatos republicanos mientras se acercan las elecciones de medio término.
datos: Donald Trump, presidente de EE. UU., apoyó al enviado especial que describió a Putin como “humanitario”.
El presidente anunció la retirada de sanciones a Rusia para intentar reducir el precio del diésel en EE. UU..
La medida se produce en la recta final de la campaña para las elecciones de medio término de noviembre de 2026.
Varios candidatos republicanos expresaron su molestia por el acercamiento de Trump a Putin.
El objetivo declarado de levantar las sanciones es abaratar el diésel para consumidores e industria.
articles.conclusion: La estrategia de Trump busca beneficios económicos inmediatos, pero corre el riesgo de dividir a la base republicana y afectar su desempeño en los midterms, al tiempo que indica un giro pragmático en la política estadounidense hacia Rusia.
